( function () {
	'use strict';

	var disabledProp =
		window.StyleSheet &&
		Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor( StyleSheet.prototype, 'disabled' );

	if ( ! disabledProp || ! disabledProp.set ) {
		return;
	}

	// Stylesheets the router owns and may legitimately toggle per page: the ones the
	// server rendered, plus the ones the router adds for a fetched page, which it
	// always stages as media="preload" before inserting them.
	var routerManaged = new WeakSet();

	function enroll( node ) {
		routerManaged.add( node );
	}

	function init() {
		document
			.querySelectorAll( 'link[rel="stylesheet"], style' )
			.forEach( enroll );

		new MutationObserver( function ( records ) {
			records.forEach( function ( record ) {
				record.addedNodes.forEach( function ( node ) {
					if ( 'preload' === node.media ) {
						enroll( node );
					}
				} );
			} );
		} ).observe( document.documentElement, {
			childList: true,
			subtree: true,
		} );

		Object.defineProperty( StyleSheet.prototype, 'disabled', {
			configurable: true,
			get: function () {
				return disabledProp.get.call( this );
			},
			set: function ( value ) {
				if (
					value &&
					this.ownerNode &&
					! routerManaged.has( this.ownerNode )
				) {
					return;
				}

				disabledProp.set.call( this, value );
			},
		} );
	}

	if ( 'loading' === document.readyState ) {
		document.addEventListener( 'DOMContentLoaded', init );
	} else {
		init();
	}
} )();
